name: User Rhino 8 orchard reference
source: User-supplied ShrinkWrap and Reduce Mesh screenshots
purpose: Reference settings for genuine Rhino runs and future backend comparisons; not a preset for the current voxel/SDF engine

separate_reduce_mesh_operation.locked_vertices: Unspecified: Show is a display toggle, not proof of locked vertices

screenshot_statistics.note: The screenshots show different polygon counts; do not assume they describe the same mesh or use these counts as fixed targets for new input.

interpretation: ShrinkWrap optimization 50% and Reduce Mesh by 75% are separate operations; do not multiply them into a claimed final face count.
For point-cloud input, Fill holes in input objects has no effect in Rhino 8 according to the command reference.
Negative offset compensates point inflation; it is not a negative support radius.
The current voxel/SDF mesher cannot reproduce these controls directly and does not load this preset.
